note: Denylist of money-touching surfaces. `evolve` refuses to experiment on, or promote into, any path matching one of these — permanently, at the contract layer (initiatives/evolve/PLAN.md non-negotiables). Entries are PATH GLOBS matched over whole path segments against the LOWER-CASED path, never a substring search over three words: lib/stripe/webhook-handler.ts names no money keyword and is still refused, by the **/*stripe*/** vendor glob. Adding an entry is a normal edit. REMOVING an entry is not permitted by Phase 00 — the refusal is the point.
why_infix: v1 used `**/<kw>*`, which required the keyword to START a segment. The adversarial pass got `app/(pricing)/page.tsx` through — a Next.js route group naming the literal pricing route — along with `app/user-billing/x`, `lib/vendor-stripe/x` and `app/(checkout)/page.tsx`. v2 patterns are infix (`**/*<kw>*`), so a keyword anywhere in a segment matches. This over-matches by design: a denylist protecting money fails CLOSED.
